Other.why_it_matters: Reflects conditions that can affect agricultural commodity prices, input costs, or farm policy.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by December 31?
Energy & Inputs.event_title: Crude Oil all time high by...?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (10% odds) on crude reaching a new all-time high. Closes in ~3mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $100 in September?
Energy & Inputs.event_title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in September 2026?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (2% odds) on crude reaching $100. Closes today. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in September?
Energy & Inputs.event_title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in September 2026?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (1% odds) on crude dropping below $85. Closes today. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (6% odds) on crude reaching $95. Closes today. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.event_title: How many Fed rate cuts in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 97% odds of NO rate cut over the contract window. Rates holding where they are keeps operating-loan and land-carrying cost at today's level and leaves the dollar without that source of downward pressure.

Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 60% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the October 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 38% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will 1 Fed rate cut happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.event_title: How many Fed rate cuts in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 2% odds of exactly 1 rate cut over the contract window. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.
